title: apps_rg Qwen/vLLM reliability waves W0-W5 closeout

W0.summary: Baseline slice and proof discipline for targeted Qwen/vLLM reliability tests (no broad apps_rg tree claim).

W1.summary: Transport diagnostics and artifact-safe sidecars (redaction, taxonomy) for live apps_rg Qwen paths.

W2.summary: Shared HTTP GET /v1/models preflight semantics before live chat; competencies gate uses HTTP models probe, not TCP-only proof.

W3.summary: Bounded transient-only retries on chat/completions (timeouts, narrow 5xx, transient URL/OS errors); no semantic/schema retry; attempt trace in diagnostics.

W4.summary: Opt-in Docker restart path: post-restart readiness requires HTTP /v1/models with model id list and expected substring match; restart exit 0 alone is not ready; readiness JSON under --artifact-dir when set.

W5.summary: Docs-only infra guidance: Docker Compose HTTP healthcheck example, image pinning policy, operator runbook, explicit proof boundary vs product/cert claims.

proof_scope: W0-W5 taken together cover documented and tested apps_rg Qwen/vLLM transport, diagnostics, bounded retries, and opt-in post-restart readiness plus operator infra guidance
Explicit non-goals: full resume pipeline proof, X3 outcome proof, full apps_rg test tree, release certification
explicit_non_claims: Does not prove live model narrative quality or end-user resume quality
Does not prove X3 ALLOW or any single final disposition
Does not prove the full tests/unit/apps_rg tree or full integration surface
Does not prove release certification, Fort Knox, or compliance sign-off
W5 wave: documentation and manifests only — no runtime behavior change in W5
No X2/X3 weakening; no agentic_core edits in these waves
